```yaml
name: Private Proof Benchmark Pages

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  benchmark:
    name: Run private‑proof E2E benchmark
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run benchmark script
        run: npm run benchmark:private:e2e

      - name: Upload benchmark artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: private-proof-benchmark
          path: benchmarks/private-proof-e2e/**

  publish-pages:
    name: Publish benchmark results to GitHub Pages
    needs: benchmark
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout gh-pages branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: gh-pages
          path: gh-pages
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm

      - name: Download benchmark artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: private-proof-benchmark
          path: gh-pages/benchmarks/private-proof-e2e

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          cd gh-pages
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update private proof benchmark results" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin gh-pages
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
